title: New picture words and new hands
items: New choice on the Word Wizards screen: One picture word per sound, or More picture words. It starts on one picture word per sound. The sound cards have new picture words, mouth hints and catchphrases.
Number Wizards shows numbers on new hands: one hand up to 5, two hands up to 10, with the raised fingers in the number's colour.
The number 6 is now a clearer purple.

title: Word-first sound cards
items: Word Wizards can now show a picture first and ask what sound it starts with. Turn it over, then tap Sound for the sound or Word for the word.
39 new picture words, each said aloud, so the same sound shows different pictures (a sun, then a seal, then a snake).
New toggle on the Word Wizards screen: Letter first or Word first.
Picture cards are silent unless you switch on "Say it aloud automatically" in the settings. Tap "Hear the word" or "Sound" when you want to hear them.
Number Wizards now shows single socks, so counting adds up.

title: A fresher look
items: New dinosaur pictures on the menu and finished screens.
Language Wizards is now Spanish Wizards.
The Voice and speed settings have gone. The app uses the recorded voices everywhere.

title: The first release
items: Word Wizards, Number Wizards, Spanish Wizards and Portuguese Wizards.
The Language Zone: English, Spanish and Portuguese words to listen to.
Light and dark colours, and it works offline.
